verdicts.summary: Build b0dc87ef1 clears the Apple HIG bar on every tab: one left edge, 44 px targets on the 8-pt grid, zero layout shift on 36 measured loads, no toasts, no stock Gradio chrome, axe-clean headings and contrast, and a tab strip that follows the WAI-ARIA pattern. All nine round-3 items, the four round-4 items, the six round-5 items, the eight round-6 items, the round-7 pair and every numbered claim I could exercise (33–84) verify on the live Space, with the measurements cited above; only claim 25 could not be exercised because all fifteen cells are now qualified, and claim 55 needs a hosted-read failure I did not induce. Comboboxes never paint a list on Tab-arrival or Tab-away, reopen after Escape, and open below the field on the phone without covering the header. Refusals on Try, Playground and LLM move nothing at 375/414/1024/1440, name the range in one field message and one status echo, and clear on edit. The Mojo path is proven by /health (19/19 loaded .so libraries at the REPUBLISH-006 revisions) and by the Hub package, whose only execution path is a ctypes call. The governed flow reached the real engine four times: receipt with expected_value and probability_of_loss, a real 409 on Execute again, and correct observe/govern intercepts. Every race S cell is compute-bound and won by the kernel with the printed parity; the board rows match the cards. I found no P0 or P1; six P2 polish items remain — the live Primes L size is 1,500,000 rather than the claimed 2,000,000, Float boxes still step 1.0 with arrow keys, the Permalink input is editable, the Refresh control vanishes for a 60 s countdown, the Races Reproduce block prints a container path, and the Hub table drops its backends column at 900 px. My concurrent test load pushed host load to 12–15, and the Try hero truthfully answered 'not recorded' naming the failing gate and lane once, as claimed. Verdict: SHIP on all six tabs.

verdicts.reviewer: Google product/engineering quality reviewer (Material bar: performance, reliability, error handling, console, CLS, a11y, i18n-safe copy)
verdicts.summary: Build b0dc87ef1 on https://thyn-ai-algenta.hf.space meets the Material quality bar on every axis I measured: zero console errors, zero CLS, zero axe violations across 36 tab/theme/viewport scans, six tabs interactive in 1.1–2.3 s from a fresh context, and every api_name answering real output over three or more calls with four concurrent visitors queued on the native lane rather than failing. All 84 numbered claims I could verify on the live Space held, including the 20 kernels/-namespace Hub links (all 200), the one-line footer stamp at 1024/1100/1180/1440, 44 px controls everywhere, the combobox Tab-arrival/Escape/click contract, the phone Race list opening below the field, and the qualification note matching qualified.json verbatim. The Mojo path is proven rather than asserted: /health names 19 loaded ctypes libraries at the REPUBLISH-006 v1 revisions and the Hub package's only execution path is a ctypes call. Designed error states behave as specified on Try, Playground, Races (unknown candidate), LLM kernels and Governed, with one field message, one status echo and 0 px movement at 375/414/1024/1440; the three governed presses produced a real receipt, the engine's real 409 idempotency hold and the observe-profile intercept. The five-cell roster wins every S cell with parity printed (Levenshtein 46.6×, Betweenness 4.95×, Closeness 6.07×, Greeks 1.87×, Primes 36.4×) and Greeks wins at M and L. Thirty-two random Playground functions opened fully prefilled, interval_add and line_intersection included, and 31 ran to a result card. Six P2 polish items remain: the stock Gradio 429 toast when the HF edge throttles a shared IP, press feedback of 95–190 ms before any status change, boot rows summing to 5.5 s under a 5.6 s foot, a noisy race card printing 'not recorded' twice, the webhook body box clipping a line, and two unexplained native-lane failures in /health counters. The govern profile and the hosted-read failure wording were not exercised (press budget, not triggerable). No P0 or P1 defect found; every tab is SHIP from this reviewer.

verdicts.reviewer: Sceptical technology journalist and fakes hunter (round 13, build b0dc87ef1)
verdicts.summary: I set out to prove the flagship fake and could not: every number I lifted from the six tabs traced to the kernel, an independent reference, /health, the Hub API, GitHub or api.algenta.ai. The hero z/p equal statsmodels to the printed digit, the Levenshtein result equals my own nltk run on the regenerated seeded strings, haversine equals the R = 6371.0 formula to 13 digits, and race ratios on card and board agree to three significant figures. All 19 families are loaded compiled .so libraries via ctypes with provenance snapshots equal to the Hub's live v1 heads, and the published package's only execution path is a ctypes call. The Ecosystem downloads, likes, package count, release tag and the 140 MCP tools each match a live external API, and the footer stamp matches /health. qualified.json names this Space's hardware and shows one honest unrecorded noisy press, while the Races copy prints the file's own rule and written stamp. The single Governed press produced a real receipt whose integrity ids match the webhook body, with expected_value and probability_of_loss as numbers and Execute again enabled afterwards; I did not spend presses on the observe/govern profiles or the 409. Layout, 44 px controls, combobox behaviour, refusals (nothing moves at 375/414/1024/1440), reduced-motion, contrast and axe (zero violations, both themes) all held, and the served copy carries no hedge words or retired-Space links. Rounds 3–8 items I could verify on the live Space are fixed. What remains is P2: the umbrella row swaps the Hub's zero downloads for a publish date disclosed only in a closed accordion, the refusal slot reserves two lines on desktop, and dead source still defaults a GPU tile to the deleted governed-agent host without rendering it. SHIP on all six tabs from this reviewer.
